name: Side note
definition: Small margin annotation explaining how to read the main visual.
bestUse: Clarifying method next to a chart.

demo.how: The chart carries the message; a small note in the margin explains how to read one part of it. Play draws the chart, then adds the note in muted type and a thin leader line to the dip it refers to, so the caveat sits next to the data instead of in a footnote.
